snippet.title: Wave Leads You... // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578960/Wave_Leads_You

A simple 2D action puzzle game that conveys waves to lead you to the goal. Make full use of scaffolding blocks that can be shaken like waves to reach the goal.

Developed by 
powder
